data.title: Cowork, from *zero*
data.subtitle: Hand Claude a whole job, not one question at a time.

blocks.text: Claude doing **multi-step work** for you: research, files, spreadsheets, decks. No code, no terminal.

blocks.old: Chat: you ask, it answers, one prompt at a time.
blocks.new: Cowork: you describe the result, it plans, works and hands back files.

items: Make one folder just for Claude
Read the plan, then let it run

blocks.text: Before you start, interview me. One question at a time. Then show me your plan.

items: **Plugins**: skills and connectors for a role, in one package
**Connectors**: your apps and data, with your own permissions
Adding a plugin doesn't sign you in to its connectors
Uses more of your limit than a chat
Local files need the desktop app open
It can still be wrong: check the output

blocks.text: Money, messages sent as you, important files? Switch to **Manually approve**.
